answers.core:
If a $1/month level is not added, I cannot afford to monetarily support the engine. I am sure this is the same for many others.

Therefore, it is my belief that a $1/month level being added to the Godot Engine's Patreon will allow many more who are passionate about Godot to support the project.

title: Add a $1/month donator level to the Patreon.
